main_text.head: LEGES
main_text.p: Τὰ σύμβολα κύρια ἔῃ) ἐπιπλὴν [illegible, ~5 letters] δικαστηρίῳ κυρωθῆ.
Μὴ μισησιχαεῖν **** μήτε ἀδί[?] μήτε δίκαιον λέγειν.
Αν τις δικάζηται παρὰ τὰς ὅρκους, [?] καὶ παρὰ φύλαρχι παραχαλάσθαι, [illegible, ~8 letters] δὲ Ἀρχοντας παρὰ πύπου [?] ἐπωζελίαν ὀφείλειν.
Υποφαίνειν ὁδὸν πλανωμένοις, καὶ [?] ζωὴν [?] τὸν βίον ὕδατος ἢ πυρός.
Δακτυλιογλύφῳ μὴ ἐξεῖναι σφραγῖδα [?] φυλάττειν τὴν τεθνεῶτος δακτυλίου.
LAUS DEO[?] [illegible, ~1 letter]Fœdera rata sunto, postquam à iudicibus approbata sunt.
[illegible, ~1 letter]Omnem memoriam discordiarum oblivione delento, neque fas neque nefas exprobranto.

[illegible, ~2 letters]Si quis in ius vocat aduersus hoc iusiurandum [illegible, ~3 letters]reus exceptione utitor: eaque de re Archontes primùm iudicia reddunto: prior qui exceptione utitur[?], dicito: qui causa ceciderit, epobelia multator.
[illegible, ~2 letters]Erranti viam monstranto, peregrinos tecto excipiunto.
Annularius expressum annuli, quem vendidit, signum apud se ne habeto.

page.notes: The Greek is blurred and partly faint; readings marked [?] are doubtful. Several line ends run to the edge of the scan and are read only as far as visible. Some words of the first lines are uncertain, notably "κύρια", "ἐπιπλὴν" and "φύλαρχι". The heading and the closing "LAUS DEO" are printed in capitals, with the final O of DEO not fully clear. The left margin holds cut-off Greek marginal fragments; only their position is recorded, the letters cannot be read. The running head is cut at the left, so only "ATTICÆ" is visible. The page number "95" is at the top right. The line "D. OPT. MAX." has its first letter cut off at the edge.
